Create Standard WorldView-3 Bands

Source: R/extension-eo.R
worldview3_bands.Rd

Helper function to create standard band definitions for WorldView-3 sensors.

Usage

worldview3_bands()

Value

A list of EO band objects representing WorldView-3 bands.

Examples

bands <- worldview3_bands()
#> Warning: 'yellow' is not a standard common_name.
#> ℹ Standard names: coastal, blue, green, red, rededge, rededge071, rededge075,
